title: Practice 4: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: «пере-»: переводить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том ___ (пронести) в палату Мэри бутылку виски.
exercises.prompt: Tom smuggled a bottle of whiskey into Mary's hospital room.
exercises.why: «про-»: пронести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«со-»: сойти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

«Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Как только я отучусь, я ___ (уезжать) из этой страны.
exercises.prompt: I'll leave this country as soon as I graduate.
exercises.why: «у-»: уезжать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«вы-»: вывозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Tom raised his glass to his lips.
exercises.why: «под-»: поднести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том ___ (переехать) в Финляндию и стал оленеводом.
exercises.prompt: Tom moved to Finland and became a reindeer herder.
exercises.why: «пере-»: переехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«про-»: проплывать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В рот, закрытый глухо, не ___ (залететь) муха.
exercises.prompt: A fly does not fly into a shut mouth.
exercises.why: «за-»: залететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
